fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: The invoice's own identifying number, exactly as printed. Not a purchase-order number and not a customer number.

fields.name: issue_date
fields.description: The date the invoice was issued, as an ISO-8601 date.

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: The date payment is due, as an ISO-8601 date. Absent on many invoices; leave it null rather than inferring one from payment terms.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The ISO-4217 currency code of the amounts on this invoice.

fields.name: total
fields.description: The final amount payable, including tax. If the document shows both a pre-tax and a post-tax total, this is the post-tax one.

fields.name: supplier
fields.description: The party issuing the invoice and expecting payment.

fields.name: tax_id
fields.description: The supplier's tax registration number, if printed.

fields.name: line_items
fields.description: One entry per charged line on the invoice, in the order printed.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What was supplied, as printed on the line.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: How many units the line charges for.
